gaps.lead: The committee probably won't change the rules.
gaps.sentence: ___ the committee will change the rules.
gaps.explanation: probably won't = it is (highly) unlikely that.

gaps.lead: Her French improved because she spent years in Lyon.
gaps.sentence: Her French improved as ___ in Lyon.
gaps.explanation: as a result of + noun/-ing = because of.

gaps.lead: You can borrow the car, but you must drive it carefully.
gaps.sentence: You can borrow the car ___ it carefully.

gaps.lead: He can't be in Spain — I saw him here this morning.
gaps.sentence: He ___ in Spain — I saw him this morning.
gaps.explanation: can't/cannot possibly be = it is impossible that he is.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly because he wanted us to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so that + subject + would/could expresses purpose.
last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).
